errors.description:
Errors for the current run.  Only the ids are persisted.  However, the full detail will be populated when
calling the `status` function on the job.

bundleStatuses.description: A list of {@link BundleStatus} that contains the status of each batch for this job.

title: A custom {@link BatchJobStatus} for {@link UiBundler}. It adds fields to expose the webpack stats and performance profile.
name: UiBundlerStatus
